papers.title: An Analysis of the Functions and Impacts of Debt Payment Moratoriums (PKPU) from the Perspective of Justice
papers.abstract: Postponement of Debt Payment Obligations (PKPU) is a legal mechanism that provides an opportunity for debtors who are unable to pay debts to get more time to carry out debt restructuring and avoid bankruptcy. This study aims to analyze the function and impact of the Suspension of Debt Payment Obligations (PKPU) on debtors and creditors and assess its conformity with the principles of justice. The research method used was normative juridical with a legislative approach and a conceptual approach. The results of the study show that PKPU has its main function as a means of debt restructuring to provide opportunities for debtors to avoid bankruptcy while providing legal certainty for creditors in fulfilling their rights. In practice, PKPU can have various impacts, both positive and negative. Procedurally, the PKPU mechanism has basically reflected the principles of justice, but it still leaves loopholes that allow violations to occur. Therefore, it is necessary to strengthen regulations and strict supervision so that the implementation of PKPU can better reflect the principles of legal justice as a whole.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】延期偿债义务（PKPU）是一种法律机制，旨在为无力偿还债务的债务人提供更多时间进行债务重组，从而避免破产。本研究旨在分析延期偿债义务（PKPU）对债务人和债权人的影响，并评估其是否符合正义原则。研究采用规范法学方法及立法分析与概念分析相结合的研究方法。研究结果表明，PKPU的主要功能在于作为债务重组的手段，为债务人提供避免破产的机会，同时为债权人履行权利提供法律保障。在实践中，PKPU可能产生正面或负面的影响。从程序上看，PKPU机制基本体现了正义原则，但仍存在一些漏洞，可能导致违规行为的发生。因此，有必要加强相关法规并加强监管，以确保PKPU的实施能够更好地体现整体法律正义原则。。

papers.title: FISCAL SUSTAINABILITY IN THE INDIAN STATES: A PANEL ARDL APPROACH
papers.venue: EPRA International Journal of Multidisciplinary Research (IJMR)
papers.abstract: In this paper, we examine fiscal sustainability for 20 Indian states over the period 1991-2021 by using an ARDL panel approach, which accommodates variables that may be of different integration orders. In the present study, we have estimated the short-run and long-run relationship between debt-to-GDP and government primary balance and found that the Indian states are fiscally sustainable in the short and long run. Panel Granger causality test results indicate that there is unidirectional causality from debt to the primary balance.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本文采用ARDL面板分析法，研究了1991至2021年间印度20个邦的财政可持续性，该方法能够处理具有不同整合阶数的变量。研究发现，印度各邦在短期和长期内均具备财政可持续性。面板格兰杰因果关系检验结果表明，债务与政府初级财政收支之间存在单向因果关系，即债务的增加会导致初级财政收支的恶化。。

papers.title: Data-Driven Duration Management -- Term Structure Forecasting Using Machine Learning
papers.abstract: This paper compares different methods for forecasting the term structure of U.S. and European zero-coupon government bonds using both traditional econometric and Machine Learning (ML) approaches. We compare classical models (e.g., Dynamic Nelson-Siegel (DNS) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA)) with different Neural Network (NN) architectures, including those inspired by the classical models, on the U.S. Treasury market and bonds issued by the European Central Bank (ECB). To enhance predictive performance, macroeconomic variables are incorporated. The findings for both markets are separately analyzed and compared. To this end, we propose a robust model evaluation framework combining statistical accuracy metrics - such as RMSE, MAE, and directional accuracy - with the economic relevance of a quantitative bond trading strategy. Results show that NNs consistently outperform traditional models in both forecasting accuracy and portfolio performance. For the U.S., the most effective approach is a direct-forecasting NN that incorporates DNS factors to reduce the dimensionality of zero-rate data and an Autoencoder (AE) to extract macroeconomic features, while for Europe, the optimal model is a factor-based NN using PCA-derived zero-rate factors without the integration of macroeconomic variables. Overall, the paper demonstrates how combining traditional modeling approaches with modern ML techniques and evaluation can improve yield curve forecasts and support applications in fixed-income portfolio construction.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文比较了多种预测美国和欧洲零息政府债券期限结构的方法，这些方法既包括传统的计量经济学方法，也包括机器学习（ML）技术。我们分别在美国国债市场和欧洲中央银行（ECB）发行的债券上，将经典模型（如动态Nelson-Siegel（DNS）模型和主成分分析（PCA））与不同类型的神经网络（NN）架构进行了对比，其中一些神经网络架构借鉴了经典模型的思想。为了提升预测性能，我们还纳入了宏观经济变量。我们对两个市场的研究结果进行了单独分析并进行了比较。为此，我们提出了一个稳健的模型评估框架，该框架结合了统计准确性指标（如均方根误差（RMSE）、平均绝对误差（MAE）和方向准确性），以及定量债券交易策略的经济相关性。研究结果表明，神经网络在预测准确性和投资组合表现方面均显著优于传统模型。对于美国市场，最有效的方法是结合DNS因素以降低零利率数据维度的直接预测神经网络，以及利用自动编码器（AE）提取宏观经济特征的神经网络；而对于欧洲市场，最优模型是不包含宏观经济变量的、基于PCA衍生零利率因素的神经网络。总体而言，本文展示了如何将传统建模方法与现代机器学习技术及评估工具相结合，以改进收益率曲线预...。研究方法：机器学习、神经网络。

papers.title: Robust Hedging Valuation Adjustment under Liquidity--Demand Stress
papers.abstract: This paper develops a robust hedging valuation adjustment (HVA) measure for dynamic hedging. Simulated rebalancing and maturity-unwind trades generate a loss distribution for each no-trade-band rule, and we define robust HVA as the worst-case expected loss over a relative-entropy neighborhood of that distribution. Because band width affects turnover, the same relative-entropy radius applied to different bands can imply different levels of demand-liquidity stress. We distinguish a fixed-radius convention from a fixed benchmark-stress convention and show that wider no-trade bands lower rebalancing costs but raise hedge-error risk.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文提出了一种用于动态对冲的稳健对冲估值调整（HVA）方法。通过模拟再平衡操作和到期平仓交易，我们得到了每种无交易区间规则下的损失分布，并将“稳健HVA”定义为该分布在其相对熵邻域内的最大预期损失。由于区间宽度会影响交易频率，因此对不同区间应用相同的相对熵半径可能会产生不同的需求-流动性压力。我们区分了基于固定半径的评估方法和基于固定基准压力的评估方法，并发现较宽的无交易区间虽然能够降低再平衡成本，但会增加对冲误差风险。。

papers.title: Research on the Driving Effect of Jiangsu Football Super League on the County Economy of Jiangsu Province
papers.abstract: As a hallmark local sports IP in Jiangsu, the Jiangsu Football Super League links professional and grassroots football. Its multi-dimensional economic driving values in boosting county consumption, promoting industrial integration and enhancing regional brand awareness have initially emerged. Based on the background of building a strong sports nation and the high-quality development of county economy in Jiangsu, this study systematically discusses the strategic positioning, driving mechanism and practical mode of Jiangsu Football Super League in promoting the county economy of the province. The study finds that Jiangsu Football Super League should be positioned as a new growth pole of county economy in the province, a catalyst for sports industry integration and an adhesive for coordinated regional development. Its economic driving value is realized through three core paths: direct consumption stimulation, industrial integration linkage and brand value empowerment. In addition, three differentiated practical modes have been formed in southern, central and northern Jiangsu, namely industrydriven mode, culture and tourism integration mode and traffic diversion mode.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】作为江苏地区具有代表性的体育IP，江苏足球超级联赛将职业足球与基层足球紧密联系在一起。它在促进县域消费、推动产业融合以及提升区域品牌知名度方面展现了多维度的经济驱动作用。基于建设体育强省的总体目标以及江苏县域经济的高质量发展背景，本研究系统探讨了江苏足球超级联赛在推动全省县域经济发展中的战略定位、驱动机制及实践模式。研究发现，江苏足球超级联赛应被定位为全省县域经济的新增长极、体育产业融合的催化剂以及区域协调发展的纽带。其经济驱动作用主要通过三条核心路径实现：直接刺激消费、促进产业融合以及提升品牌价值。此外，根据江苏南部、中部和北部的不同地域特点，形成了三种差异化的实践模式，分别是产业驱动模式、文化旅游融合模式以及交通引流模式。。

papers.title: Research on the Impact of Short Selling System on Enterprise Artificial Intelligence Application
papers.abstract: This study employs a quasi-natural experiment of incremental expansion in margin trading and short selling systems, analyzing the impact of short-selling mechanisms on corporate AI adoption using a DID model with a sample of A-share listed companies from 2015 to 2025. The findings demonstrate that short-selling mechanisms significantly enhance corporate AI adoption, partially mediating this effect through increased R&D investment. Robustness tests using alternative indicators such as AI patents further validate the primary conclusions. The research indicates that capital market institutions can drive corporate intelligent transformation through external governance mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文旨在探讨做空机制对企业人工智能应用的影响。

🔬 研究方法：本文选取2015至2025年A股上市公司为样本，利用融资融券和做空系统增量扩张的准自然实验，采用双重差分（DID）模型进行实证分析。

📊 核心发现：研究发现做空机制显著提升了企业的人工智能应用，且该效应部分通过增加研发投资实现；使用AI专利等替代指标的稳健性检验进一步验证了上述结论。

💡 应用价值：研究结果表明，资本市场机构能够通过外部治理机制有效推动企业的智能化转型。

papers.title: Evaluation of the Trans Halim City Transportation Business Activity Policy, Puskopau Unit, Halim Perdana Kusuma Jakarta, in the Perspective of Public Policy and Law Number 5 of 1999
papers.venue: International Journal of Social Welfare and Family Law.
papers.abstract: This study aims to evaluate the public policy of Trans Halim city transportation business activities managed by the Air Force Cooperative Center (PUSKOPAU) at Halim Perdana Kusuma Airport, Jakarta, in the perspective of public policy theory and Law Number 5 of 1999 on the Prohibition of Monopolistic Practices and Unfair Business Competition. Using empirical juridical research with a socio-legal approach combined with policy evaluation frameworks including the Dunn model and CIPP evaluation approach, this study examines the alignment between PUSKOPAU's territorial-based business operations and the regulatory mandates of Indonesian competition law. Field observations and interviews conducted with drivers, management, and transportation organization representatives confirm that PUSKOPAU operates as a sole provider on specific routes within and around the Halim Perdana Kusuma military complex, constituting indicators of natural monopoly behavior. The study applies rule of reason analysis and public interest theory to assess whether such monopolistic conditions are justified by cooperative law exemptions under Article 50(i) of Law No. 5/1999. Findings reveal that while PUSKOPAU's operations serve member welfare objectives consistent with cooperative law, the extension of services to the general public creates a legal grey area, particularly given the absence of KPPU regulatory guidelines for cooperative exemptions. This legal gap produces significant policy uncertainty and hampers effective enforcement. The article recommends that KPPU promptly formulate specific guidelines for cooperative monopoly exemptions and that formal KPPU investigation procedures be initiated to determine the legality of PUSKOPAU's market dominance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究旨在从公共政策理论以及1999年《禁止垄断行为和不公平商业竞争法》的角度，评估由雅加达哈利姆佩尔达纳库苏马机场空军合作中心（PUSKOPAU）管理的公共交通业务活动。通过采用社会法律方法的实证法律研究，并结合包括Dunn模型和CIPP评估方法在内的政策评估框架，本研究分析了PUSKOPAU的地域性业务运营与印度尼西亚竞争法监管要求之间的契合度。通过对司机、管理人员及交通组织代表的实地观察和访谈，研究发现PUSKOPAU在哈利姆佩尔达纳库苏马军事基地及其周边地区特定路线上处于独家服务提供商的地位，这符合自然垄断的特征。研究运用理性规则分析法和公共利益理论，探讨此类垄断状况是否能够依据1999年《禁止垄断行为和不公平商业竞争法》第50(i)条中的合作组织豁免条款得到合法化。研究结果表明，尽管PUSKOPAU的运营符合合作组织法的宗旨并服务于成员利益，但其服务向公众的扩展引发了法律上的灰色地带，尤其是由于印度尼西亚竞争委员会（KPPU）尚未制定针对合作组织豁免的具体指导原则。这一法律空白导致了政策执行的不确定性，并阻碍了有效监管。文章建议KPPU尽快制定明确的合作组织垄断豁免指南...。

papers.title: Analisis Harga Pokok Produksi CPO terhadap Penentuan Harga Jual di PT. Perkebunan Nusantara IV Regional II
papers.abstract: The palm oil industry is a strategic commodity that contributes significantly to Indonesia's foreign exchange. Determining the correct and competitive selling price of Crude Palm Oil (CPO) depends heavily on the accuracy of calculating the cost of goods sold (COGS). Errors in calculating COGS can result in the selling price being too low, thus causing losses to the company, or too high, thus reducing competitiveness in the market. This study aims to determine the amount of CPO production cost and the profit obtained by PT. Perkebunan Nusantara IV Regional II based on the selling price achieved in 2024. This study uses a descriptive quantitative approach with a method of collecting production costs using process costing and a method of determining COGS using full costing which includes raw material costs, direct labor costs, and fixed and variable factory overhead costs. The data used are secondary data obtained from the company's 2024 financial statements. The results show that the total production cost is IDR 2,925,998,297,226 with a total production of 661,904,862 kg of CPO, resulting in a COGS of IDR 4,420.57/kg. With an average selling price of Rp12,722,337/kg, the company's total revenue reached Rp8,420,976,716,302 and a profit of Rp5,494,978,419,076 per year. The results of this study indicate that the accurate application of the full costing method can be used as a basis for determining optimal selling prices and increasing company profitability.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】棕榈油产业是一种具有战略意义的商品，对印度尼西亚的外汇收入贡献巨大。确定棕榈油（CPO）的合理且具有竞争力的售价在很大程度上取决于销售成本（COGS）计算的准确性。如果销售成本计算出现误差，可能会导致售价过低，从而给公司带来损失；或者售价过高，进而降低公司在市场中的竞争力。本研究旨在根据PT. Perkebunan Nusantara IV Regional II公司在2024年实现的售价，来计算其棕榈油的生产成本及获得的利润。研究采用描述性定量方法，通过过程成本法收集生产成本数据，并运用完全成本法（包括原材料成本、直接人工成本以及固定和变动制造费用）来确定销售成本。所使用的数据来自该公司2024年的财务报表。研究结果显示，总生产成本为2,925,998,297,226印尼盾，总产量为661,904,862公斤棕榈油，因此每公斤的销售成本为4,420.57印尼盾。在平均售价为12,722,337印尼盾的情况下，该公司当年的总收入达到8,420,976,716,302印尼盾，利润为5,494,978,419,076印尼盾。研究结果表明，准确应用完全成本法可以作为确定最优售价和提高公...。

papers.title: The association between estimated glucose disposal rate and self-reported diabetic retinopathy: evidence from two independent cohorts and machine learning
papers.abstract:
Background
                    Insulin resistance plays a key role in the pathogenesis of diabetic retinopathy (DR). Although established insulin resistance markers have been shown to predict a variety of complications, the association between the estimated glucose disposal rate (eGDR) and prevalence of DR remains incompletely characterized. This study aims to examine the relationship between eGDR and DR prevalence.
                  
                  
                    Methods
                    This cross-sectional study analyzed complete participant data (N = 1, 536) from the 2007–2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) for all relevant information. The relationship between the insulin resistance index and self-reported DR prevalence was evaluated by using multivariate logistic regression and a restricted cubic spline (RCS) model. Subgroup analysis was conducted to assess heterogeneity across groups, and two sensitivity analyses were performed to assess the robustness of the results. In machine learning, the Boruta algorithm is applied for feature selection. The selected features are subsequently utilized by XGBoost and random forest models for DR prevalence estimation. Use the Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) value to explain the independent contribution of eGDR. In the clinical cohort, we recruited patients who visited the Second Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University from September 1, 2025, to December 30, 2025. A total of 297 participants who met the inclusion criteria were finally enrolled. Multivariable logistic regression and RCS curves were used to validate the findings from the NHANES analysis.
                  
                  
                    Results
                    In the fully adjusted model, eGDR and self-reported DR prevalence show a significant negative linear correlation (OR = 0.79, 95% CI: 0.67–0.93, P = 0.0049). Subgroup and sensitivity analyses confirm the stability of this negative association. The Boruta algorithm identifies eGDR as a robust and important feature. Both the XGBoost (AUC = 0.773) and random forest (AUC = 0.764) models show moderate predictive performance, and eGDR has high variable importance. SHAP analysis indicates that eGDR, together with body mass index and income poverty, is a key determinant of self-reported DR prevalence. The results of the clinical cohort are like NHANES.
                  
                  
                    Conclusion
                    This cross-sectional study suggested that lower eGDR is associated with a higher prevalence of self-reported DR. Accordingly, eGDR may serve as a potential marker for risk stratification rather than a causal or preventive factor. Prospective longitudinal research is necessary to confirm these findings and to explore whether a causal relationship exists.
papers.summary_zh:
【风险管理与衍生品】**背景**  
胰岛素抵抗在糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）的发病机制中起着关键作用。尽管已确定的胰岛素抵抗标志物已被证明能够预测多种并发症，但估计的葡萄糖代谢率（eGDR）与DR患病率之间的关联仍尚未得到充分研究。本研究旨在探讨eGDR与DR患病率之间的关系。  

**方法**  
本研究采用横断面分析方法，分析了2007–2018年全国健康与营养调查（NHANES）中所有参与者的完整数据（N = 1,536）。通过多元逻辑回归和限制性三次样条（RCS）模型评估了胰岛素抵抗指数与自我报告的DR患病率之间的关系。进行了亚组分析以评估不同群体间的异质性，并进行了两次敏感性分析以验证结果的稳健性。在机器学习中，使用Boruta算法进行特征选择；选出的特征随后被XGBoost和随机森林模型用于DR患病率的预测。利用Shapley加性解释（SHAP）值来解释eGDR的独立贡献。在临床队列研究中，我们招募了2025年9月1日至2025年12月30日期间就诊于安徽医科大学第二附属医院的患者，最终共有297名符合纳入标准的参与者被纳入研究。多元逻辑回归和RCS曲线被用来验证NHANES分析的结果。...。研究方法：回归分析、调查数据、机器学习、横截面分析。

papers.title: Hipper: A Scalable AI Framework for High-Precision ERP Prediction
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  With the growing demand for global satellite navigation and high-resolution Earth observation, improving the precision and timeliness of Earth Orientation Parameter (EOP) predictions has become an urgent requirement for national major engineering applications. Deep learning neural networks, owing to their ability to automatically learn temporal structures such as trends and seasonality, have shown promising potential in EOP prediction. To address current limitations in methodological integration and software extensibility, we developed Hipper (High-Precision Prediction of ERP with AI), a scalable and extensible software framework for Earth Rotation Parameter (ERP) prediction. The software integrates five core functional modules: user interface, data preprocessing, algorithm library, model integration, and evaluation visualization. It incorporates multiple signal decomposition methods and approximately 20 algorithmic models, including classical approaches (LS+AR) and AI-based models (CNN, LSTM, Transformer variants). In addition, it supports hybrid-model construction and scale-dependent integrated prediction strategies, thereby providing a practical environment for method benchmarking, hybrid-model development, and operational-oriented prediction experiments. Comparative experiments with representative results from the 2nd Earth Orientation Parameters Prediction Coordination Campaign (2nd EOP PCC) and related&#xD;studies show that Hipper achieves overall prediction performance comparable to representative benchmark methods under the current framework setting.These results indicate that the framework provides an effective technical basis for high-precision ERP prediction and offers a reusable platform for future methodological development.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
随着全球卫星导航和高分辨率地球观测需求的不断增长，提高地球定向参数（EOP）预测的精度和时效性已成为国家重大工程应用中的迫切需求。深度学习神经网络凭借其自动学习时间序列结构（如趋势和季节性变化）的能力，在EOP预测领域展现出巨大潜力。为解决当前方法集成和软件可扩展性方面的局限性，我们开发了Hipper（一种基于人工智能的高精度ERP预测系统），这是一个可扩展且易于扩展的地球自转参数（ERP）预测软件框架。该软件包含五个核心功能模块：用户界面、数据预处理、算法库、模型集成以及评估可视化工具。它整合了多种信号分解方法和约20种算法模型，包括传统方法（如LS+AR）以及基于人工智能的模型（如CNN、LSTM、Transformer变体）。此外，Hipper还支持混合模型构建和基于尺度变化的集成预测策略，为方法评估、混合模型开发以及面向实际应用的预测实验提供了实用的环境。通过与第二次地球定向参数预测协调活动（2nd EOP PCC）及相关研究的对比实验表明，在当前框架设置下，Hipper的预测性能可与主流基准方法相媲美。这些结果表明，该框架为高精度ERP预测提供了有效的技术基础...。研究方法：实验方法、深度学习、神经网络。

papers.title: A lightweight hybrid ViT-GNN framework for data-centric land cover mapping in the amazon biome using graph structural priors
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Continuous monitoring of the Amazon biome demands land cover classification models that are both highly sensitive and computationally feasible. To resolve the inherent trade-off between architectural complexity and predictive performance in spatial deep learning, this study introduces the Vision Transformer–Graph Neural Network with Feature Adaptation (ViT-GNN RFFA). In contrast to conventional end-to-end pixel models, this hybrid architecture operates exclusively on an 11-dimensional vector of extracted color-based vegetation indices (e.g., GRVI) and textural statistics. The dual-branch design isolates global sequence context via the ViT module while leveraging the GNN branch as a structural prior to learn non-linear covariance between specific features. Evaluated against a suite of benchmarks including MiniViT, Baseline CNN, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM, the proposed algorithm attained the highest Overall Accuracy of 0.930 utilizing merely 16,323 trainable parameters—a nearly 75% reduction in footprint versus pixel-based models. Crucially, a McNemar’s statistical test confirmed that the accuracy gain over the strongest classical baseline (XGBoost, OA: 0.927) is statistically significant (
                    p
                     < 0.05). By pairing rigorous spatial cross-validation with an interpretable feature space, this work establishes that intelligent data pre-processing combined with graph-based relational learning offers a robust framework for high-precision environmental mapping under severe resource limitations.

papers.title: Portfolio Optimization for Commodity ETFs under Heavy-Tailed Returns
papers.abstract: This paper examines portfolio optimization for commodity exchange-traded funds (ETFs) under heavy-tailed return behavior. Using daily Bloomberg data for 30 U.S.-listed commodity ETFs from 12 December 2018 to 16 December 2024, we study funds spanning agriculture, energy, metals, and broad commodity index exposure. We compare a passive buy-and-hold portfolio with rolling-window optimized portfolios formed under mean--variance and conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) criteria, considering both long-only and restricted long--short strategies. The results showed substantial heterogeneity across commodity sectors, with energy and broad commodity index funds displaying pronounced volatility, skewness, and excess kurtosis. Historical optimization indicated that minimum-risk and CVaR-based portfolios provided more stable cumulative performance than tangent portfolios and generally improved Sharpe, Calmar, and STARR$_{0.95}$ ratios. Extreme-value diagnostics showed that optimized portfolios remained exposed to heavy downside tails, so improved risk-adjusted performance did not eliminate extreme-loss risk. A dynamic extension based on ARMA--GARCH marginal models, Student--$t$ copula dependence, and one-step-ahead predictive scenarios improved performance mainly when combined with minimum-risk or CVaR-based objectives. Dynamic mean--variance tangent portfolios performed less reliably, reflecting sensitivity to expected-return estimation error. Transaction-cost robustness checks further showed that the practical value of dynamic optimization depended on turnover control, with low-turnover dynamic CVaR tangent portfolios remaining more resilient to implementation costs. Overall, the analysis showed that commodity ETF allocation benefited most from conservative and downside-risk-aware optimization, while optimized portfolios continued to require explicit tail-risk and implementation diagnostics.
